Job Description:
About Shiftbase

At Shiftbase, we build workforce software that helps people get work done. Thousands of teams across Europe use our platform every day to plan shifts, track time, and manage leave, with less admin in the way.

Our engineering team is 18 people from a mix of backgrounds. The culture is open. Anyone can push back on an idea regardless of title.

Why this role exists now

We develop AI-assisted, with Claude Code as our primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts that way. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. Testing is the piece that hasn't caught up, and that makes it the most interesting engineering problem here right now. Nobody has a settled playbook for quality in AI-assisted development, and you'd help write ours.

This year the whole team moves to continuous deployment, releasing automatically on every change that passes our checks. That only works if the tests are trustworthy. Our web end-to-end coverage is solid and already replaced manual web regression. Mobile still rides on a multi-day manual regression, only engineers can author tests, and we haven't mapped the gaps.

About The Role

You're the engineer who makes our test automation good enough to release on. You build, stabilise, and extend the suites, with mobile as your first big target, and you help the people around you get better at testing while you do it.

You work alongside our QA engineers and partner with the development teams driving the wider move to continuous deployment. Each QA engineer works with dedicated development teams.

Year one, in order

First, kill the manual mobile regression. It costs us multiple hours on every mobile release and it's the biggest blocker to continuous deployment. This is your first big deliverable.
Then, make the end-to-end suite a trusted merge gate. Stable, fast, and with a false-failure rate low enough that nobody argues with a red build.
Along the way, put test authoring in more hands. You build the setup and do the pairing so QA testers write their end-to-end tests with AI and developers keep tests as part of their normal flow.


What You'll Do

Build out mobile test automation and retire the manual regression as a release gate
Map where coverage is strong and where it's thin, then close the gaps that matter most for shipping safely.
Make the framework and tooling approachable enough that QA testers and developers author tests themselves, then pair with them until they do.
Track flakiness, coverage, escaped defects, and cycle time so we can see whether the suite is getting more trustworthy.
Feed what you learn into the testing workflow for continuous deployment.


How We Work

Backend in PHP, frontend in Angular, a web app and a mobile app. End-to-end tests run in Playwright & Maestro. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code. CI already runs linters, unit tests, end-to-end tests, and SonarQube, and we're hardening these into enforced merge gates.

Must-haves

You've made a suite trustworthy at scale. You built or stabilised end-to-end and integration suites that a team relied on to gate merges or releases, and you know the work that took.
You work in the codebase as a peer. You read and write code alongside developers and reason about APIs, data, and integration points, not only the UI.
You make others better. You pair, review, and explain well enough that people around you level up, without needing a title to be heard.
Ideally you've built mobile test automation before. If not, show us you've stood up automation on an unfamiliar platform and made it stick, fast.


Nice-to-haves

You've been part of a team's move to frequent or fully automated releases
Experience working alongside AI-assisted development
Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries)


This might be your dream job if…

✅ You want to take a strong test suite the last mile to continuous deployment

✅ You get energy from getting developers to own quality, not from being the gatekeeper

✅ You like working in the codebase yourself, not only writing test plans

✅ You believe automated testing should let a team move faster, not slow it down

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You prefer manual testing and writing test cases over building automation

⛔️ You want to be the last line of defence catching bugs by hand

⛔️ You'd rather work in isolation from developers than embed quality into how they work

⛔️ You need the tooling and process handed to you fully decided

You'll need the right to work in the Netherlands. We can sponsor visas for this role, and you'll need to be at our Zoetermeer office on hybrid days. We are not open to relocators.

Configure and maintain AI-assisted quality pipelines across the delivery lifecycle — from solution-document and AC review through test generation, PR risk scoring, and production signal analysis.

Job Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Salesforce Performance Tester with JMeter based in Netherlands.

As a Salesforce Performance Tester, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of complex Salesforce applications and their integrated systems. You will leverage your expertise in Apache JMeter to design and execute comprehensive performance, load, stress, and endurance tests across enterprise platforms. Working with Salesforce developers, architects, QA specialists, and integration teams, you will identify bottlenecks and deliver actionable recommendations to optimize application performance. Your responsibilities will span Salesforce modules, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end business workflows. This fully remote contractual opportunity offers the chance to contribute to technically challenging projects in a collaborative, technology-driven environment. You will use data-driven analysis and structured testing methodologies to help ensure applications remain stable and responsive under demanding workloads. Candidates with strong hands-on expertise and immediate or short-notice availability are particularly encouraged to apply.

Accountabilities

Salesforce Performance Testing: Design, develop, and execute performance testing strategies and test plans for Salesforce applications and enterprise implementations. 
Conduct load, stress, spike, endurance, and scalability testing to assess application behavior under different user loads, transaction volumes, and operating conditions. 
Evaluate critical business workflows, including record creation and updates, searches, reports, dashboards, and complex transactions across Salesforce environments. 
Test Salesforce solutions such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Lightning Experience, as applicable to project requirements. 
Identify performance issues related to Salesforce configurations, customizations, Apex transactions, Lightning components, and external integrations. 
Apache JMeter Test Development: Build, maintain, and execute reusable performance test scripts and modular test plans using Apache JMeter. 
Configure Thread Groups, HTTP Request Samplers, Controllers, Timers, Assertions, Listeners, and other JMeter components to simulate realistic workload scenarios. 
Develop parameterized and data-driven scripts using CSV files, variables, and correlation techniques, ensuring reliable session management and authentication. 
Configure and execute HTTP/HTTPS requests, headers, cookies, tokens, and request payloads for realistic performance testing scenarios. 
Run distributed and non-GUI load tests for large-scale performance assessments and analyze results to evaluate response times, throughput, error rates, and concurrent-user performance. 
API and Integration Testing: Perform performance testing of Salesforce REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Bulk APIs, and other relevant interfaces. 
Assess integrations between Salesforce and external applications, middleware platforms, and third-party systems, validating response times, throughput, reliability, and error handling under concurrent loads. 
Apply knowledge of OAuth 2.0, access tokens, refresh tokens, and Salesforce API limits to develop reliable and representative test scenarios. 
Identify bottlenecks in API requests, integration services, downstream dependencies, and data-intensive operations. 
Performance Analysis and Optimization: Analyze response-time distributions, latency, throughput, error rates, and other performance indicators to identify application and integration bottlenecks. 
Investigate slow transactions and performance degradation in collaboration with Salesforce developers and architects, reviewing relevant debug logs, Apex execution, governor limits, and platform constraints. 
Recommend performance improvements based on test findings, monitoring data, and root-cause analysis. 
Conduct regression performance testing following fixes, configuration changes, and optimization initiatives. 
Reporting and Collaboration: Prepare detailed performance test reports, dashboards, execution summaries, and actionable recommendations for technical stakeholders. 
Document test scenarios, workload models, test data requirements, assumptions, results, and reusable testing assets. 
Present findings, risks, bottlenecks, and optimization recommendations to QA teams, developers, architects, DevOps specialists, and business stakeholders. 
Participate in defect triage, root-cause analysis, performance reviews, and cross-functional discussions to support continuous improvement. 

Requirements

6–9 years of experience in software testing, with substantial hands-on experience in performance testing and analysis. 
Strong practical expertise in Apache JMeter, including script development, test execution, workload configuration, result analysis, and performance reporting. 
Proven experience conducting performance testing for Salesforce applications and Salesforce-based enterprise solutions. 
Hands-on experience with load, stress, spike, endurance, and scalability testing methodologies. 
Strong understanding of REST APIs, SOAP APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, XML, and web communication protocols. 
Experience with API authentication, OAuth 2.0, access and refresh tokens, parameterization, correlation, and session management. 
Solid understanding of performance metrics, including response time, throughput, latency, concurrent users, and error rates. 
Demonstrated ability to interpret test results, troubleshoot performance degradation, and identify application, API, and integration bottlenecks. 
Knowledge of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, Apex transactions, and API usage constraints. 
Experience with test data management, defect tracking, test documentation, and structured performance reporting. 
Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams. 
Nice to have: Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Lightning Experience. 
Nice to have: Familiarity with Salesforce Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce integration patterns. 
Nice to have: Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, New Relic, or Grafana. 
Nice to have: Experience integrating performance testing into CI/CD pipelines and automated testing workflows, including familiarity with Jenkins, Git, and cloud-based testing environments. 
Nice to have: Experience with Salesforce event monitoring, debug logs, performance diagnostics, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and large-scale enterprise implementations involving complex integrations. 
Availability: Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period are preferred. 
Ability to work effectively in a fully remote contractual engagement and communicate findings clearly to distributed teams. 

Benefits

100% remote work: Perform your responsibilities remotely, with the position based in the Netherlands. 
Contractual engagement: Opportunity to contribute specialized performance testing expertise to Salesforce technology projects. 
Technically challenging work: Test complex Salesforce implementations, APIs, integrations, and enterprise business workflows. 
Specialist impact: Help improve application stability, scalability, responsiveness, and overall user experience through data-driven performance optimization. 
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Salesforce developers, architects, QA professionals, integration specialists, and other technical stakeholders. 
Advanced tooling: Apply Apache JMeter and relevant performance monitoring and diagnostic tools to investigate and resolve complex technical challenges. 
Professional development: Further develop expertise in Salesforce performance testing, API validation, enterprise integrations, and performance engineering.

Job Description:
Wat ga je doen

Performancetesten is een standaard onderdeel van de UWV-testaanpak. Het centrale, divisie-overstijgende performancetestteam test de performance van tientallen, binnen UWV ontwikkelde, applicaties. Deze applicaties hebben zeer diverse architecturen en technologieën (webservices, batchverwerkingen, client-server applicatiestacks), wat een grote uitdaging vormt.

Door de toenemende Agile werkwijze, containerisatie en het gebruik van CI/CD-pipelines, zal het performancetesten steeds eerder in het ontwikkelproces plaatsvinden. Het team moet zijn diensten hier continu op aanpassen.

Jouw rol 

Als performancetester ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledig zelfstandig uitvoeren van complete performance-testtrajecten. Je werkproducten bestaan uit testplannen, scripts en de uiteindelijke rapportages. Je bent ervaren genoeg om zelfstandig te werken, maar weet ook wanneer je hulp moet zoeken om de planning te halen.

Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt nauw samen met applicatie-eigenaren, Agile/DevOps-teams en andere stakeholders.

Coördineren van activiteiten met alle betrokken partijen. 
Schrijven van het performancetestplan. 
Bouwen van scripts in Jmeter en incidenteel in Loadrunner. 
Uitvoeren van de performancetest. 
Gebruiken van observability tools om performance te analyseren. 
Analyseren en visualiseren van meetgegevens (met InfluxDB, Grafana en Perfana). 
Schrijven van het meetrapport met conclusies, eindoordeel en aanbevelingen. 
Communiceren over de voortgang met de opdrachtgever en het ontwikkelteam. 
Bij productiestoringen op het gebied van performance, deelnemen aan de oplossingsgerichte taskforce. 

Wat we van je verwachten

Je bent een ervaren specialist die technisch de diepte in kan gaan, maar tegelijkertijd in staat is om boven de materie te staan. Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken vertalen naar begrijpelijke risico’s, keuzes en adviezen voor verschillende stakeholders.

Je beschikt over: 

Minimaal HBO informatica diploma of een vergelijkbaar werk- en denkniveau. 
Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in de afgelopen 5 jaar met performancetesten van GUI applicaties en/of webservices. 
Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in de afgelopen 5 jaar met Jmeter of andere performancetest tools. 
Minimaal 1 jaar werkervaring in de afgelopen 3 jaar met: 
Performancetesten in verschillende soorten omgevingen. 
Werken in Agile trajecten. 
Het opstellen en uitvoeren van performance testplannen. 

Functie-wensen: 

Je bent TMAP en/of ISTQB gecertificeerd. 
Je hebt een flexibele werkhouding (geen 9-tot-5-mentaliteit) en bent bereid om incidenteel in avonduren of weekenden te testen. 
Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken. 
Je hebt ervaring met monitoringtools zoals Dynatrace en Grafana. 
Je kunt hoofd- van bijzaken scheiden en je prioriteiten stellen en bewaken. 

Wat kun je van ons verwachten

Uiteraard vragen wij niet alleen iets van jou, we hebben ook veel te bieden. Bij ons kom je in een professioneel en hecht team te werken. Wij bieden een afwisselende functie waarin samenwerken en uitdagingen voorop staan. UWV biedt uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een goed salaris, een dertiende maand en een keuzeplan om je arbeidsvoorwaarden aan te vullen. Bij UWV werken we afwisselend thuis en op kantoor, conform het concept ‘hybride werken’.

Het gaat om een functie van 38 uur per week tot en met WAVE 3. Salarisindicatie, afhankelijk van je werkervaring: € 5.217,- en € 6.909, - (bij een 38-urige werkweek).

Iets meer over ons

Concern-ICT bestaat onder andere uit de afdelingen Gemeenschappelijke Informatie Voorziening, ICT Services, Leveranciersmanagement en CIO-Office. Je gaat werken bij ICT Services, team Testdiensten ICT Services.

ICT Services is aanspreekbaar op de (on)beschikbaarheid van alle applicaties en de onderliggende infrastructuur. Het doel van ICT Services is het actief en blijvend maximaliseren van de beschikbaarheid en het sturen op de (in de SLA) vastgestelde procesnormen en service niveaus. De missie is zorgdragen voor de beschikbaarheid van de ICT Infrastructuur voor nu en de toekomst met zo efficiënt mogelijk gebruik van de beschikbare middelen.

Job Description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Reliability Engineer with focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) to join the Corporate Engineering team. As an SRE together with other engineers you will be responsible for the continuous operation, further development and enhancement of Planet’s corporate infrastructure and applications, acting as the technical authority for our enterprise identity ecosystem.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own

Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).
Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).
Scripting & Tooling: Use Python or Go to automate repetitive tasks, build custom provisioning connectors for legacy applications, and enforce identity data minimization.
Identify and reduce operational toil through automation, making our systems self-healing and predictable.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Leverage APIs, Terraform, Ansible, or SaltStack to manage configurations as code, moving away from manual UI/CLI changes across our identity platforms.
Participate in an on-call rotation and drive the continuous improvement of incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes for complex authentication failures.
Collaborate closely with Security and other IT teams to embed reliability, scalability, and security best practices from the ground up, ensuring our identity architecture complies with GDPR and Zero Trust principles.

What You Bring

6+ years experience in infrastructure development and/or operations, with a dedicated focus on Identity and Access Management.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.
Expertise with a scripting language like Python.
Track record of working with large web applications or computer clusters and managing complex identity architectures (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).
Experience integrating HR Information Systems with identity directories and handling complex edge cases (re-hires, cross-border transfers).
Solid understanding of Network principles and operations alongside modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).
Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.

What Makes You Stand Out

Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.
Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production environment.
Awareness of best practices about systems security and defensive programming
Experience with version control e.g. Git.
Experience in deploying and maintaining virtual machines e.g. KVM, ProxMox.
Experience in software development using CI/CD processes and tools e.g. Jenkins, GitLab.
Experience with Access Control systems, e. g. Avigilon, Verkada or dormakaba.
Experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and deployment automation, renewal, and revocation of personal S/MIME certificates.
